# What leaves the site

A site agent sends Neura only the fields listed here and drops anything else before it leaves the server. Every message it sends is also recorded in the site's hash-chained outbound ledger (`neura-agent outbound --summary`, `--verify`), so a customer can check what was sent rather than trust this page. Camera images, robot state, actions and instructions are in no message, by construction of the protocol.

Telemetry modes (`NEURA_AGENT_TELEMETRY_MODE`): `standard` sends every field below; `minimal` sends only the fields marked *minimal*: health, versions, identifiers, states and reason codes, with no free text and no metrics.

Schema version 1.
